title: Natural Classification of Planets — Benefic and Malefic
summary: Natural benefics are Jupiter, Venus, well-associated Mercury, and waxing Moon. Natural malefics are Sun, Mars, Saturn, evil-associated Mercury, and waning Moon.
full_text: According to natural classification, benefics are Jupiter, Venus, well-associated Mercury, and waxing Moon. Malefics are the Sun, Mars, Saturn, evil-associated Mercury, and waning Moon. References to malefics and benefics in this book — unless otherwise stated — are in the sense of functional malefic lords and benefic lords, not the natural classification.

title: Double Lordship Principle — Both Lordships Determine Functional Nature
summary: All planets except Sun and Moon own two houses. A planet's functional benefic/malefic nature must be determined by considering both lordships together, not just one. The ascendant is the primary determinant.

The ascendant is of utmost importance while deciding the benefic and malefic lords, as the same planet can own trine houses for one ascendant and dusthana houses for another.

title: Yoga Strength Modifier — Functional Quality of Forming Planets Determines Yoga Intensity
summary: A yoga formed by functional malefic lords (e.g., lords of 6th, 11th) is weaker than the same yoga formed by functional benefic lords (e.g., lords of 4th, 9th). The ownership quality of yoga-forming planets directly scales yoga strength.

title: Yoga and Arishta — Two Grand Divisions of Human Life Outcomes
summary: All human life events fall into two grand divisions: Yogas (fortunes) and Arishtas (misfortunes). Yogas cover health, wealth, career, family, and happiness. Arishtas cover illness, deformity, poverty, suffering, and loss.

Yogas include success in every line: health, personality, success in politics, financial gains, good education, mental strength, bodily health, good wife, dutiful children, sympathetic friends and relations, righteous conduct and other sources of pleasure and enjoyment. Arishtas or misfortunes include all sorts and sources of sorrows, worries, miseries, troubles, distress, bodily and mental disturbances such as ill-health, physical and mental deformities, financial losses, ugly and bad children, quarrelsome wife, hateful relations and friends, evil temper, sinful nature and other unpleasant sources in life.

summary: Before interpreting a yoga, three factors must be determined: (1) functional good and evil lords for the ascendant, (2) inherent (shadbala) strength of the yoga-forming planets, (3) residential strength (house occupation percentage) of those planets.

title: Shadbala vs Saptavargaja — Accurate Strength Method Always Preferred
summary: Shadbala (6 sources of strength) is the accurate method for determining planetary strength. Saptavargaja bala (strength from 7 divisional charts) is the approximate fallback. When both methods conflict, Shadbala always takes precedence.
full_text: There are two methods of ascertaining planetary strengths. The accurate method is Shadbala — the six sources of strength and weakness as described in Graha and Bhava Balas. The approximate method is Saptavargaja bala — the strength a planet gets from its disposition in a friendly, neutral, or inimical Rasi, Hora, Drekkana, Sapthamsa, Navamsa, Dwadasamsa, and Thrimsamsa. The approximate method should only be used when the accurate method cannot be applied. When a planet is strong by the approximate method but weak by Shadbala, the Shadbala result always takes precedence.

title: Residential Strength — House Occupation Percentage Determines Result Delivery
summary: Residential strength reveals the percentage of results a planet can actually deliver based on its physical position within a Bhava (house). A planet at 90% residential strength delivers nearly full yoga results; one at 24% delivers minimal results.
full_text: Residential strength reveals the percentage of results a planet is capable of giving by virtue of occupation of a house. This requires the determination of Bhavas (house longitudes), Bhava sandhis (junctional points) and the lengths of Bhavas. A planet deep in a house has high residential strength; a planet near a house junction has low residential strength. Even a yoga-forming planet with high inherent (shadbala) strength will only partially deliver yoga results if its residential strength is low.

title: Yogakaraka Unit Scoring System — Net Positive or Negative Determines Yoga Delivery
summary: Each yoga-forming planet (yogakaraka) is scored with positive and negative units. Positive: functional benefic lord (+1), conjunct benefic lord (+1), aspected by benefic lord (+1), exalted or friendly sign (+1). Negative: functional malefic lord (−1), conjunct malefic (−1), aspected by malefic (−1), debilitated or inimical sign (−1). Net score determines whether the yogakaraka strengthens or weakens the yoga.
full_text: A yoga is formed by at least two planets. For each yogakaraka, assign positive units: +1 if it is a functional benefic lord; +1 if associated (conjunct) with a functional benefic lord; +1 if it receives the aspect of a functional benefic lord; +1 if in exaltation or friendly sign. Assign negative units: −1 if it is a functional malefic lord; −1 if associated with a functional malefic lord; −1 if it receives the aspect of a functional malefic lord; −1 if in debilitation or inimical sign. Note: 3rd and 4th (drishti) aspects may also be taken into account. If positive units predominate, the yogakaraka confers predominantly beneficial results for a beneficial yoga. If negative units predominate, the yogakaraka gives diminished or no beneficial results.

summary: Of the two planets forming a yoga, the one with greater inherent (shadbala) strength fulfils the larger portion of the yoga's indications during its own Dasa. The weaker planet fulfils a smaller share as sub-lord.

title: Dasa Timing of Yoga Manifestation — Four Principles
summary: A yoga is experienced primarily during the Dasa of the stronger yogakaraka. The weaker yogakaraka's sub-period within any Dasa also activates the yoga partially. The native cannot enjoy the yoga during the Dasa of a yogakaraka whose residential strength is very low.
full_text: The timing of yoga manifestation follows four principles: (1) The yoga will be enjoyed throughout the Dasa of the stronger yogakaraka, subject to sub-lord influences. (2) The weaker yogakaraka's Antardasha within the stronger yogakaraka's Dasa is excellent for the yoga, but delivery is capped by the weaker planet's residential strength. (3) During the weaker yogakaraka's sub-period in any Dasa, the yoga will manifest to a small proportion. (4) During the stronger yogakaraka's Antardasha in any Dasa, the yoga will be felt to a fairly good proportion, subject to the disposition of the major Dasa lord. A planet cannot deliver yoga results at full strength if it cannot 'enjoy' its own Dasa (e.g., native is outside the Dasa period).

title: Gajakesari Yoga — Jupiter in kendra from Moon
summary: When Jupiter occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon, Gajakesari Yoga is formed, producing lasting fame, intelligence, generosity, and a reputation that endures beyond the native's life.
full_text: Gajakesari Yoga is formed when Jupiter is in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th house) from the Moon. The word 'Gajakesari' means 'elephant-lion', signifying the combined strength and majesty of these two animals. The native will be a king or equal to a king, self-made, intelligent, wealthy, and of good reputation. The quality of the yoga depends on the nature of the occupying planet(s): benefic planets give more wholesome results; malefics give wealth through exertion or struggle.

title: Kemadruma Cancellation Conditions
summary: Kemadruma Yoga is cancelled (and its negative results negated) when: (1) planets occupy a kendra from Lagna, (2) planets occupy a kendra from Moon, or (3) Moon is in conjunction with any planet.
full_text: The three standard cancellation conditions for Kemadruma Yoga are: (1) A planet occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Lagna; (2) A planet occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon; (3) The Moon itself is in conjunction with any planet. The house in which the yoga falls critically modifies the result — favorable houses (2nd, 9th, 10th, 11th) produce legitimate gain; unfavorable houses indicate debased character.

full_text: Vanchana Chora Bheethi Yoga ('fear of deception, thieves, and danger') is formed by three sets of combinations, any one of which is sufficient: (a) The Lagna is occupied by a malefic planet and Gulika is disposed in the 5th or 9th house (trine); (b) Gulika is associated with the lords of kendras and trikonas (lords of 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th, 5th, and 9th houses); (c) The lord of Lagna is combined with Rahu, Saturn, or Ketu. In all these cases, the native will not only have chronic fears from cheats, rogues and thieves but will also suffer material losses. The yoga's combinations are found in almost all horoscopes, indicating that cheating and being cheated operates universally in various forms. The yoga applies equally to victims of fraud and to those who perpetrate deception. Gulika is considered the son of Saturn and his zodiacal position must be carefully calculated.

full_text: Sakata Yoga is formed when the Moon occupies the 6th, 8th, or 12th house reckoned from Jupiter. These are the three dusthanas (houses of difficulty) from Jupiter, obstructing the free flow of fortune. The native loses fortune and may regain it — fortune fluctuates. The native will be ordinary and insignificant, suffer from poverty, privation and misery, be stubborn and hated by relatives. Note: Parasara and Varahamihira give an alternative definition (all planets in 1st and 7th = Sakata), but Raman prefers the dusthana-from-Jupiter definition as more rational. The effects are periodic, not permanent.

title: Amala Yoga — Natural benefic in 10th from Lagna or Moon

full_text: Amala Yoga ('pure/spotless') is formed when a natural benefic planet occupies the 10th house reckoned from either the Lagna or the Moon. 'Amala' means pure, and the yoga produces prosperity and affluence through fair means. The native achieves lasting fame and reputation, with spotless character. A malefic in the 10th gives wealth in its dasa but through questionable means, and does not bestow lasting fame or character. Due consideration must be given to the strength of the planet causing Amala (Shadbala) and its aspects and associations.

title: Parvata Yoga — Three Formation Variants
summary: Parvata Yoga forms via three variants: (a) benefics in kendras + 6th/8th empty; (b) benefics in kendras + 6th/8th occupied by benefics; (c) lords of Lagna and 12th in mutual kendras. Gives wealth, liberality, and local prominence. NOT applicable to Kumbha Lagna for variant (c).
full_text: Parvata Yoga ('mountain', implying stability and prominence) has three valid formation definitions: (a) Benefics are disposed in kendra houses (1st, 4th, 7th, 10th) AND the 6th and 8th houses are both unoccupied — this is the cleanest form, and also frees the native from enemies and debts; (b) Benefics in kendras AND the 6th and 8th are occupied by benefics (not necessarily free); (c) The lords of Lagna and the 12th house are in mutual kendras (each in a kendra relative to the other's position). Exception: variant (c) cannot apply to Kumbha (Aquarius) Lagna since the lord of both the Lagna and the 12th is Saturn — one planet cannot be in a mutual kendra with itself. In practice, Parvata Yoga adds financial stability and local recognition but is not powerful enough to minimize major yogas or bestow political power.

title: Vesi Yoga (Subhavesi) — Benefic planets in 2nd from Sun

summary: When Jupiter occupies a kendra house that is simultaneously his own sign (Sagittarius or Pisces) or exaltation sign (Cancer), Hamsa Yoga is formed — one of the five Panchamahapurusha Yogas. Gives sterling character, righteous disposition, handsome body, and universally liked nature.
full_text: Hamsa Yoga is one of the five Panchamahapurusha Yogas (great man yogas) described by Varahamihira in Brihat Samhita. It forms when Jupiter occupies a kendra house (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th from Lagna) that is identical with his own sign (Sagittarius or Pisces) or his exaltation sign (Cancer). The native's legs will have auspicious markings (conch, lotus, fish, ankusa). The native possesses a handsome body, is liked by others, righteous in disposition, and pure in mind — a man of sterling character and immense moral fibre. Possible Lagnas: movable and common signs only (Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn) — fixed sign Lagnas (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius) cannot possess Hamsa Yoga as neither Jupiter's own nor exaltation sign can coincide with a kendra from those Lagnas. Exaltation kendra > own-sign kendra (exaltation removes the issue of Jupiter's kendra lordship being undesirable). The 10th kendra is the most powerful. Malefic aspects on Jupiter restrict but do not eliminate results.

full_text: Malavya Yoga is one of the five Panchamahapurusha Yogas. It forms when Venus occupies a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th from Lagna) that is identical with his own sign (Taurus or Libra) or exaltation sign (Pisces). The native will have a well-developed physique, will be strong-minded, wealthy, happy with children and wife, command vehicles, possess clean sense-organs, and be renowned and learned. Venus governs conveyances, sensual pleasures, music, dancing, fine arts, luxury, and material comforts. Malavya Yoga gives inclination toward all Venus-signified domains — spiritual advancement is in inverse ratio to material comforts. Key distinction: both Hamsa and Malavya are Panchamahapurusha/Rajayogas, but Hamsa makes one idealistic, spiritual, broad-minded, and selfless, while Malavya indicates love of pleasure and a predominantly materialistic outlook. Malavya cannot occur for every Lagna — its manifestation depends on which Lagna allows Taurus, Libra, or Pisces to coincide with a kendra.

The native will grace a King's Council, be wealthy and full of strength, and serve as an Exchequer or Comptroller of treasury. title: Sreenatha Yoga — 7th lord exalted in 10th + 10th lord conjoined with 9th lord
summary: When the 7th lord is exalted in the 10th house AND the 10th lord is conjoined with the 9th lord, Sreenatha Yoga is formed. Practically applicable only to Sagittarius Lagna. Gives Vishnu body marks, godly nature, agreeable speech, good family.
full_text: Sreenatha Yoga is an important Raja Yoga establishing contact between the 7th, 9th, and 10th houses — signifying both power and wealth. Requirements: (1) The 7th lord must be exalted in the 10th house; AND (2) The 10th lord must be conjoined with the 9th lord. In strict classical interpretation, this yoga can occur ONLY for Sagittarius Lagna, where Mercury (7th lord) is exalted in Virgo which is the 10th house from Sagittarius. For no other Lagna can the 7th lord remain exalted in the 10th. An extension — if the exalted 7th lord could aspect the 10th (rather than occupy it) — could include Cancer and Libra Lagnas, but Raman was uncertain about this departure. Results: the native will have on his body the insignia of Vishnu (conch, wheel, etc.), be an agreeable speaker, godly, have a good wife and children, and be loved by all.

title: Malika Yoga Formation Rule — All 7 planets in 7 consecutive houses
summary: Malika Yoga forms when all seven planets (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn — Rahu/Ketu excluded) occupy seven consecutive houses without a gap. The starting house determines which of the 12 Malika types is present. 12 varieties exist, one per starting Bhava.
full_text: Malika Yoga ('garland yoga') is formed when all seven classical planets (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn — Rahu and Ketu excluded) occupy seven consecutive houses in the horoscope without any gap. The starting Bhava (the first of the seven occupied houses) determines the specific Malika type. There are 12 types, one for each possible starting Bhava: (1) Lagna Malika (starting 1st), (2) Dhana Malika (2nd), (3) Vikrama Malika (3rd), (4) Sukha Malika (4th), (5) Putra Malika (5th), (6) Satru Malika (6th), (7) Kalatra Malika (7th), (8) Randhra Malika (8th), (9) Bhagya Malika (9th), (10) Karma Malika (10th), (11) Labha Malika (11th), (12) Vraya Malika (12th). Results vary significantly by starting house — favorable houses give prosperity, unfavorable houses (6th, 8th) give poverty or suboptimal results. Multiple Malika types may theoretically be read from one chart if the configuration wraps around.

triggers.description: (b) Jupiter in Gopuramsa (own varga 4 times) AND aspected by a benefic

results.classical_note: Chart 108 (born 30-9-1946): Jupiter at 9°16' in Thula (odd sign) = own navamsa (Dhanus) + Mrudwamsa. This yoga confers intuitive prophetic ability, not merely astrological skill. Raman: sages must have perceived further evolution of the soul through intuition.

engine_flags.flag: Y234 trigger t1 — Mrudwamsa requires D60 precision AND own-navamsa coincidence
engine_flags.detail: Jupiter must simultaneously satisfy: (1) in Mithuna/Thula/Kumbha, (2) between 9°-9°30' within the sign (Mrudwamsa = 19th D60 division of odd sign), (3) in own navamsa (Dhanus navamsa = 3rd navamsa of these signs = 6°40'-10°). The window 9°-9°30' falls within 6°40'-10°, confirming the coincidence. D60 computation required.

engine_flags.flag: Y234 trigger t2 — Gopuramsa requires multi-varga computation
engine_flags.detail: Gopuramsa = own varga in at least 4 divisional charts. For Jupiter: own sign Dhanus or Meena in Rasi (D1), Drekkana (D3), Chaturthamsa (D4), Sapthamsa (D7). Engine must compute Jupiter's sign in each divisional chart and count own-sign occurrences. Full Shodasavarga computation required.

triggers.description: Additional variant (from Remarks): 9th lord in 7th + 7th lord in 4th + Lagna lord or 11th lord in kendra

results.effect: The person will have intimacy with any number of women (multiple wives)
results.classical_note: Chart 110 (born 6-4-1886): 7th lord Mars and Lagna lord Venus in mutual aspect, both associated with Rahu and Ketu. Mars also aspected by Saturn. Native reputed to have multiple wives. Raman: 'number of wives' in modern context = intimacy with many women.

engine_flags.flag: lords_mutual_aspect_or_conjunction — new condition type
engine_flags.detail: Engine must check both conjunction (same sign) and all directional aspects (using full Parashari aspect tables) between Lagna lord and 7th lord. The mutual aspect check requires verifying that each planet's aspect rays reach the other planet's house.

triggers.description: 7th lord joins or is aspected by Jupiter

triggers.description: Primary: 7th lord in 4th house in conjunction with Venus

results.classical_note: 7th lord (spouse signifier) in 4th (intimate/private house) with Venus (sensual pleasure). Remarks extend result to debilitation of Lagna lord in Rasi or Navamsa.

conditions.description: A strong natural benefic occupies Lagna (1st), 3rd, or 5th house
The same strong benefic simultaneously aspects the 9th house
conditions.engine_note: Jupiter in Lagna aspects 9th by 9th-house aspect. Jupiter in 5th aspects 9th by 5th-house aspect. Any benefic in 3rd aspects 9th by 7th-house aspect. Only Jupiter can give yoga from Lagna or 5th — Venus/Mercury/Moon aspect only by 7th, so cannot reach 9th from 1st or 5th.

results.effect: The subject will be extremely fortunate, pleasure-loving and rich
results.classical_note: Kataka Lagna with exalted Jupiter (9th lord in Lagna) = powerful Bhagya Yoga. Mithuna Lagna: Jupiter gets Kendradhipatya dosha, yoga almost ineffective. Potency = sum-total strength of the benefic concerned.

engine_flags.flag: Y241 — only Jupiter can give yoga from Lagna or 5th; any benefic from 3rd
engine_flags.detail: Jupiter aspects 5th and 9th from its position. From Lagna, Jupiter reaches 9th via 9th-house aspect. From 5th, Jupiter reaches 9th via 5th-house aspect. Venus/Mercury/Moon only have 7th-house aspect — from Lagna or 5th they cannot reach 9th. Only from the 3rd does any benefic (via 7th-house aspect) reach the 9th house.

conditions.description: Sun is in the 6th, 8th or 12th house
Lord of the 8th occupies the 9th house
Lord of the 12th occupies the Lagna (1st house)
Lord of the 6th occupies the 5th house

results.effect: The subject will be a posthumous child (born after father's death)
results.classical_note: Chart 113 (born 22-3-1929): Sun in 8th; 8th lord Jupiter in 9th; 12th lord Moon in Lagna; 6th lord Saturn in 5th. All four conditions satisfied in toto. Raman insists: the entire yoga must be present — partial presence is insufficient.

triggers.description: Primary: 9th lord exalted + aspected by benefic + 9th house occupied by benefic

Variant (b): 9th lord in 4th + 10th lord in kendra + 12th lord aspected by Jupiter

results.effect: The person will be an embodiment of generosity and humanitarian charity
results.classical_note: Chart 114 (born 4-6-1884 — late Maharaja): 9th lord Jupiter exalted in Lagna with Venus; 9th aspected by Jupiter. Noted for great humanitarian instincts. Malefics in 9th deaden finer instincts even while conferring Rajayoga — generosity must be genuine, not self-serving.

Sun and/or Saturn join malefic navamsas or shashtiamsas OR are aspected by malefics

results.classical_note: Mere presence of Sun+Saturn in 10th unaspected by malefics and in benefic navamsas does NOT constitute the yoga. Jupiter's aspect on Sun-Saturn in 10th acts as antidote but at least a temporary setback remains.

engine_flags.flag: Y244 — cancellation: benefic navamsas + no malefic aspect negates yoga
engine_flags.detail: Raman explicitly states: if Sun and Saturn in 10th occupy benefic navamsas AND are unaspected by malefics, Apakeerti Yoga does not operate. Engine must check navamsa quality AND malefic aspect as mandatory conditions, not optional modifiers.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (245) — 3+ Planets in Exaltation/Own in Kendra

conditions.engine_note: Three or more planets simultaneously in exaltation or own sign AND in kendra (1,4,7,10). Raman: in practice, trikonas also suffice. Resembles Panchamahapurusha Yoga. Chart 115 illustrates with Saturn, Mars, Sun exalted in kendras from Chandra Lagna.

results.effect: The person becomes a famous king (in modern context: ruler, head of state, or position of supreme authority)
results.classical_note: Chart 115 (born 14/13-4-1924): Saturn, Mars, Sun exalted in kendras from Chandra Lagna. Sun's Dasa proved excellent from Raja Yoga standpoint. Engine may also check from Chandra Lagna per Raman's illustration.

conditions.description: A planet is in debilitation (neecha)
The debilitated planet has bright rays (not combust) OR is retrograde
The debilitated planet is NOT in a dusthana (not in 6th, 8th, or 12th)

results.effect: The person attains a position equal to that of a ruler and commands all insignia of royalty
results.classical_note: Chart 116 (born 10-10-1871): Venus debilitated in 10th, bright (not combust) and retrograde. Served as Dewan in Kashmir, Mysore, Cochin. Raman cautions: Saturn debilitated+retrograde in 10th without other relieving features can still cause considerable harm.

engine_flags.flag: Y246 — combustion check required; debilitated planet must be not-combust or retrograde
engine_flags.detail: Engine must compute combustion range for the debilitated planet from the Sun. A debilitated planet that is combust (within combustion distance of Sun) and NOT retrograde does NOT cause this yoga. Retrograde status always qualifies regardless of combustion. Non-dusthana placement is also mandatory.

conditions.engine_note: Digbala house assignments: Mercury+Jupiter in 1st (Lagna), Sun+Mars in 10th, Saturn in 7th, Moon+Venus in 4th. A planet has Digbala when in its assigned house. Two to four planets with Digbala simultaneously required.

results.effect: A person, even born in an ordinary family, will become a ruler
results.classical_note: Chart 117 (born 4-6-1884 — Indian Maharaja): Jupiter+Moon in Lagna and 4th with Digbala. A debilitated Digbala planet has reduced potency. Strength of the Digbala planets must be assessed — neecha+Digbala is considerably weaker than exalted+Digbala.

engine_flags.flag: Y247 — Digbala table must be implemented; planet strength modifies potency
engine_flags.detail: Engine must implement the Digbala house table for all 7 planets. A Digbala planet that is simultaneously debilitated or combust has reduced Raja Yoga power. Exalted or own-sign Digbala planets are maximally effective. Rahu/Ketu do not have Digbala assignments.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (248) — Kumbha Lagna 4 Exalted Planets

conditions.description: Lagna is Kumbha (Aquarius) with Venus in Lagna
Four planets are in exaltation
The exalted planets do NOT occupy malefic navamsas or shashtiamsas

results.effect: The subject becomes a ruler or an equal to him
results.classical_note: Rare — confined to Kumbha Lagna only. Requires four simultaneously exalted planets. If exalted planets are in evil navamsas/shashtiamsas, yoga fails and tyrannical tendencies manifest. Includes Neechabhanga category.

engine_flags.flag: Y248 — Kumbha Lagna only; 4 exalted planets; D9+D60 quality check mandatory
engine_flags.detail: Most restrictive Raja Yoga in the collection. Kumbha Lagna, 4 exalted planets simultaneously, and those planets must NOT be in malefic navamsas or shashtiamsas. D60 computation required. Negative result (tyrant) manifests if shashtiamsas are malefic — one of the few yogas with a defined negative outcome from a positive configuration failure.

conditions.description: Moon in Lagna (1st house)
Jupiter in 4th house
Venus in 10th house
Saturn is exalted or in own house

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or an equal to him
results.classical_note: Chart 118 (born 21-7-1895): Moon+Jupiter+Venus in Lagna/4th/10th; Saturn in exaltation. Yoga obtains in toto. Key strength: 4th and 10th fortified by two first-rate benefics (Jupiter+Venus). Gajakesari Yoga implied by Moon in 1st and Jupiter in 4th (kendra from Moon).

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (250) — Neechabhanga (Sign Lord / Exaltation Planet in Kendra)

conditions.description: A planet is in debilitation in the Rasi chart
The lord of the debilitation sign (sign lord) OR the planet that is exalted in the same sign (thaduchchanatha) is in a kendra from Moon or Lagna

The planet exalted in the same sign where the neecha planet is debilitated is in kendra from Moon or Lagna (thaduchchanatha interpretation per Prof. B. Suryanarain Rao)

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or an equal to him
results.classical_note: Chart 119 (born 8-11-1888): Sun neecha (Thula); Saturn (exalted in Thula = thaduchchanatha) in Lagna = kendra from Lagna. Great scientist with international laurels. Reckoned from both Lagna and Moon.

engine_flags.flag: Y250 — thaduchchanatha interpretation is debated; two schools
engine_flags.detail: Two interpretations: (1) lord of the exaltation sign of the debilitated planet; (2) the planet that gets exalted in the sign where the neecha planet is debilitated. Raman explicitly follows interpretation (2). Engine should implement (2) as primary, (1) as secondary. All Neechabhanga Raja Yogas are reckoned from both Lagna and Moon.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (251) — Powerful Moon in Kendra Aspected by Jupiter

Moon is aspected by Jupiter
Moon is otherwise powerful (exalted, own sign, or waxing/strong)
conditions.engine_note: Moon exalted (Vrishabha), in own sign (Kataka), or waxing (bright) qualifies as powerful. Moon being exalted 'may be said to be fairly powerful' per Raman.

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or equal in wealth, power and influence
results.classical_note: Chart 120 (born 8-8-1912): Moon exalted in kendra, aspected by Jupiter. Gajakesari Yoga implied by Moon+Jupiter in mutual kendras. Political power requires connection with Mars or Sun owning/occupying 10th — without such connection, yoga confers high non-political distinctions.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (252) — Neecha Planets in Exalted Navamsa

conditions.description: Planet(s) debilitated in Rasi should occupy exalted navamsa signs
conditions.engine_note: For each planet debilitated in Rasi: check if its D9 navamsa sign is the sign where that planet would be exalted. E.g., Sun debilitated in Thula (Libra) — Sun's exaltation = Mesha (Aries). Sun must be in Mesha navamsa. Chart 122 (born 5-11-1915): all neecha planets in Rasi chart are exalted in their Navamsa.

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or an equal to him
results.classical_note: Chart 122 (born 5-11-1915): All planets debilitated in Rasi occupy exalted navamsas. Classic Neechabhanga configuration. Raman includes all Neechabhanga Raja Yogas in Y245–Y263 and notes they function similarly to standard Raja Yogas.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (253) — Jupiter Lagna + Mercury Kendra + 9th/11th Lords

conditions.description: Jupiter is in Lagna (1st house)
Mercury is in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th)

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or equal in wealth, power and influence
results.classical_note: Chart 123 (born 22-5-1921): Jupiter in Lagna, Mercury in 10th (kendra), aspected by Mars (9th lord). Mercury is 11th lord himself. Also present: Lagna conjunct Yogakaraka Mars and 11th lord Mercury all in 10th from Lagna.

engine_flags.detail: Saturn's exaltation (Thula) and Moolathrikona (Kumbha) cannot be kendra or trikona from Kanya (3rd/6th from Kanya), Dhanus (11th/2nd from Dhanus), or Meena (8th/11th from Meena) lagnas. Engine must pre-check and exclude these three lagnas.

engine_flags.flag: Y255 — Rahu explicitly required in 5th; nominal Raja Yoga per Raman
engine_flags.detail: Rahu is explicitly named — engine must NOT apply global Rahu exclusion. However, Raman strongly questions this yoga's practical validity based on 12 chart examinations. Engine should assign LOW confidence to Y255 Raja Yoga result and simultaneously flag adverse 5th-house (children/intellect) impact from Rahu+Mars affliction.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (256) — 10th Lord in 9th with Uttamamsa

conditions.description: 10th lord occupies the 9th house
In the 9th, the 10th lord occupies an exalted or friendly navamsa
10th lord has attained Uttamamsa (own varga in 3 of the Shodasavarga divisional charts)
conditions.engine_note: Uttamamsa = planet in own varga in at least 3 of 16 divisional charts (D1–D16). Chart 125 (born 27-3-1902): 10th lord Saturn in 9th in own navamsa + occupies own vargas thrice.

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or an equal to him
results.classical_note: Chart 125 (born 27-3-1902): 10th lord Saturn in 9th occupying own navamsa + Uttamamsa (own vargas 3 times). Raman explicitly explains Uttamamsa = own varga in 3 divisional charts.

engine_flags.flag: Y256 — Uttamamsa requires full Shodasavarga multi-varga computation
engine_flags.detail: Uttamamsa = planet in own varga in at least 3 of the 16 divisional charts (D1, D2, D3, D4, D7, D9, D10, D12, D16, etc.). Engine must compute the planet's sign in each divisional chart, count own-sign occurrences, and verify ≥3 matches. Full Shodasavarga computation required.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (257) — Jupiter 5th + Gajakesari + Fixed Lagna + Lagna Lord 10th

conditions.description: Lagna is a fixed sign (Vrishabha, Simha, Vrischika, or Kumbha)
Jupiter is in the 5th house from Lagna
Moon is in a kendra from Jupiter's position
conditions.engine_note: Moon in kendra from Jupiter = Gajakesari Yoga. When Jupiter is in 5th, kendras from Jupiter = 2nd, 5th, 8th, 11th from Lagna. Moon in 2nd (wealth) or 11th (gains) are especially favourable positions.

conditions.description: Lagna lord (Lagnadhipathi) occupies the 10th house

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or equal to him
results.classical_note: Chart 126 (born 6-6-1913): Jupiter in 5th; Moon in kendra from Jupiter; fixed-sign Lagna; Lagna lord in 10th. Yoga capable of four sign variations (4 fixed signs). Moon's exact position varies — Raman notes 2nd+11th from Lagna are especially good (wealth and gains houses).

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (258) — Moon's Navamsa Lord in Kendra/Trikona

conditions.engine_note: 3-step: (1) Find Moon's navamsa sign. (2) Find lord of that navamsa sign. (3) Check if that lord is in kendra (1,4,7,10) or trikona (1,5,9) from either Lagna or Mercury. Chart 127: Moon in Mesha navamsa; navamsa lord Mars in kendra from Mercury and trikona from Lagna.

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or equal — common combination of modest potency
results.classical_note: Chart 127: Yoga present in toto but many afflictions countered it — native is neither king nor big personality. Raman explicitly: this is a common and not very powerful combination. Afflictions can neutralise it. Engine confidence should be moderate.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (259) — Vrishabha Lagna Special (Sambhuhora Prakasha)

conditions.description: Lagna is Vrishabha (Taurus)
Moon in Lagna (Vrishabha — Moon's exaltation sign)
Saturn in 10th (Kumbha — Saturn's own sign)
Sun in 4th (Simha — Sun's own sign)
Jupiter in 7th (Vrischika — friendly sign for Jupiter)

results.effect: The person becomes a commander or an equal to a ruler
results.classical_note: From Sambhuhora Prakasha. Vrishabha Lagna only: Moon exalted in Lagna; Saturn (Yogakaraka for Vrishabha) in own sign 10th; Sun in own sign 4th; Jupiter in 7th (friendly sign). Powerful Gajakesari implied. Mars excluded despite commander signification seems inconsistent per Raman.

engine_flags.flag: Y259 — Vrishabha Lagna only; 5 specific planetary placements required simultaneously
engine_flags.detail: Exclusively applicable to Vrishabha Lagna. For Vrishabha: Moon in 1st = exaltation sign, Saturn in 10th = own sign Kumbha, Sun in 4th = own sign Simha, Jupiter in 7th = Vrischika (friendly). Engine must pre-check Vrishabha Lagna first. All five conditions must be satisfied simultaneously.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (260) — Neecha Planet's Navamsa Lord in Kendra + Movable Lagna

conditions.description: A planet is debilitated in the Rasi chart
Lord of the navamsa occupied by the debilitated planet is in a kendra or trikona from Lagna
Lagna is a movable sign (Mesha, Kataka, Thula, or Makara)
Lagna lord occupies a movable sign

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or an equal to him
results.classical_note: Chart 128 (born 21-9-1866): Lagna Makara (movable); Lagna lord Saturn in Thula (movable). Jupiter debilitated; navamsa lord Saturn in kendra from Lagna. Prince of literature commanding considerable respect and riches. Raman: practical applicability not fully tested.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (261) — Rahu+Saturn 10th + Neecha Lagnadhipathi + 9th Lord Aspect

conditions.description: Lagna lord conjoins a debilitated planet
Rahu and Saturn both occupy the 10th house
conditions.engine_note: Rahu explicitly required in 10th. Engine must NOT apply global Rahu exclusion.

conditions.description: The Rahu-Saturn combination in 10th is aspected by the lord of the 9th

results.effect: The native becomes a ruler or equal to him
results.classical_note: Chart 129 (born 17-11-1944): Rahu+Saturn in 10th; Lagnadhipathi Mercury debilitated. Y261 completely present. Raman questions rationale — debilitated planet absorbs Raja Yoga power while Rahu-Saturn become enfeebled. Double-cancellation mechanism may be at work.

engine_flags.flag: Y261 — Rahu explicitly required in 10th; Raman questions yoga rationale
engine_flags.detail: Rahu is explicitly named as a mandatory participant in 10th. Engine must NOT apply global Rahu exclusion. Raman himself is unable to appreciate the rationale. Engine should assign CAUTIOUS confidence to Y261 and note its theoretical nature. In practice, debilitated Lagnadhipathi may absorb Raja Yoga power.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (262) — 11th/9th/2nd Lord in Kendra from Moon + Jupiter 2nd/5th/11th

conditions.description: At least one of the lords of 11th, 9th, or 2nd houses is in a kendra from Moon
Jupiter is lord of the 2nd, 5th, or 11th house
conditions.engine_note: Jupiter is 2nd/11th lord for Vrischika (2nd=Dhanus, 5th=Meena); 5th lord for Simha (5th=Dhanus); 11th lord for Vrishabha (11th=Meena); 2nd+11th for Kumbha (2nd=Meena, 11th=Dhanus). Applicable only to these four lagnas. Remaining eight lagnas excluded.

results.effect: The native becomes a great man or a respected ruler
results.classical_note: Chart 130 (born 30-7-1863): 11th lord Mercury in kendra from Moon; Jupiter owns 2nd and 5th. Yoga No. 262 illustrated. Applicable only to Kumbha, Simha, Vrishabha, or Vrischika lagnas where Jupiter is lord of 2nd, 5th, or 11th. Remaining eight lagnas excluded by logical necessity.

engine_flags.flag: Y262 — applicable only to Kumbha, Simha, Vrishabha, Vrischika lagnas
engine_flags.detail: Jupiter can be lord of 2nd, 5th, or 11th only for Kumbha (2nd=Meena, 11th=Dhanus), Simha (5th=Dhanus), Vrishabha (11th=Meena), Vrischika (2nd=Dhanus, 5th=Meena). Engine must pre-check lagna and return false for all other eight lagnas without evaluating c1.

yoga_name: Raja Yoga (263) — Benefic in 9th Free from Combustion with Friendly Planets

conditions.description: Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, or Moon occupies the 9th house
The benefic in 9th is free from combustion
The benefic in 9th is aspected by or associated with friendly planets

results.effect: The native becomes a great man or a respected ruler
results.classical_note: Simple and common combination completing the Raja Yoga chapter. Benefic in 9th (dharma/fortune house) free from combustion and associated with friendly influences confers distinction. Exact nature and strength of the yoga must be assessed carefully — exact degree of 9th-house benefic's overall disposition determines grade of result.
